family.amstrad-pc3000.description: Three desktop tiers for work, from the 8086 to the 386SX.
family.amstrad-pc3000.history: Amstrad documented Generation 3 in its August 1990 leaflets: PC3086 for home and small business, PC3286 as an expandable work computer, and PC3386SX at the top of the range for more demanding applications. They shared VGA and MS-DOS 3.3, with different storage and expansion options. The leaflets attribute design to the UK and manufacture to Taiwan, Korea or the UK; they do not identify the contractor for each model or batch.
